title: Partner cannot raise the pay-after-service payment request: /api/grooming-payment-sandbox returns 403 'Permission denied' for a provider session (GET on every poll, POST on 'Create payment request')
steps: Customer books grooming with 'Pay after service' (PS-UAT-MU9HH07M-2B44, collect ₹1,349 at door)
Sign in at /partner-app as 9000000901, open the job (any state incl. completed)
Observe network: GET /api/grooming-payment-sandbox?bookingId=... -> 403 on every refresh
Tap 'Create payment request'
expected: Partner sees the collection state and can create a sandbox payment request / QR for the ₹1,349 due at the door
actual: POST /api/grooming-payment-sandbox {action:request_after_service} -> 403 {"error":"Permission denied"}; UI shows 'Permission denied'. GET polls also 403 (console floods with 403s). No way to collect via the app.

title: Earnings tab says 'Service proof still outstanding ... missing before photo, after photo ... holds up the settlement' for a job whose before/after photos were uploaded, Ops-approved and recorded as service proof (settlement already accrued)
steps: Complete the grooming lifecycle in /partner-app: upload before/after, founder approves at /control, Add service proof (200), Complete job (completed)
Open Earnings tab
expected: No outstanding-proof warning; settlement shown as accrued
actual: Warning card 'Service proof still outstanding PS-UAT-MU9HH07M-2B44 · grooming — missing before photo, after photo. A completed job without its required proof holds up the settlement' is shown directly above the accrued ₹938 settlement row. Root cause: lib/provider-workspace.ts pendingProof reads provider_job_proofs (proof_type before_photo/after_photo), which the grooming lifecycle never writes; grooming proof lives in grooming_service_proof (row present with both media refs). provider_job_proofs is empty for the booking.
evidence: DB: grooming_service_proof row for PS-UAT-MU9HH07M-2B44 has both refs; provider_job_proofs has none
